design.primary: 2026 early vs later regular-season games; repeat 2023–2025.
design.split: Actual game StartTimestamp date; early is strictly before the season median recorded-game date.
design.eligibility: At least 100 throws AND 100 completed named catches, across at least 3 games in EACH role and period; single team within season.

huckShare.label: Hucks (>30 yd gain and >40 yd flight)

design.distance: Early-only z scores; mean squared difference within each of four feature groups, equal group weight; square root.
design.reference: Every early-qualified player, including those not qualifying later. Later evaluation requires the same source ID in the early reference.
design.uncertainty: 5,000 reference-team cluster bootstrap samples of per-player match metrics; conditional on the fixed profiles, scales and candidate pool.
limitations: Exploratory temporal validation; previously inspected seasons, not new external data.
Disc involvement only; no on-field exposure, routes, marking, weather or off-disc defense.
Re-identification does not validate discrete archetypes, player quality or replacement success.
Repeated seasons and players are dependent; thresholds select regular high-involvement players.
Completed catches omit unsuccessful target routes. Completion is kept out of similarity.
Team bootstrap does not propagate profile estimation or all opponent/game dependence.
Matching two players with each other is not proof their similarity persists in future games.
